title: patch_file does not support pure-insertion unified diffs
description: Two patch_file calls with pure-insertion diffs (only + lines and context, no - removed lines, orig_count=0) both failed with 'error applying hunk #1'. The diffy crate or the normalization/relocation pipeline does not correctly handle hunks where the original hunk covers zero lines. This forces agents to fall back to write_file for simple insertions, increasing write payload and causing tool-errors rubric failures.
proposed_resolution: Fix patch_file.rs to apply hunks where orig_count is 0. The relocate_hunk_positions step should handle the no-preceding-context case by anchoring on following context lines instead.
